product.title: Billing export
product.problem: Finance cannot reconcile invoices without a manual export.
flows: Open the export screen and choose a date range
requirements: The system shall export invoices for a date range
acceptance_criteria: An export of one month returns every invoice in that month
constraints: Exports must not include other tenants

technical_appendix: Uses the existing invoices table and the reporting queue.

ambiguities.text: The reporting queue retries failed exports
ambiguities.question: Is the retry policy a product requirement or an implementation detail?
